meta.parties: De Silva v. Siyadoris Et Al

rules.statement: A co-owner who builds on common property acquires no title in severalty as against other owners, but has a claim for compensation through a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right of the builder is limited to a claim for compensation, which he could enforce in a partition action under sections 2 and 5 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 2 and 5 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863
